label: Protein structures
caption: 10,949 protein domains from CATH, non-redundant at 40% sequence identity and coloured by CATH class, with about a third of each class sampled from each period of PDB deposition. Each domain is linked to its ten strongest Foldseek structural matches among earlier domains, and the domains up to 2004 by their minimum spanning tree. FlingVis was fitted to the 2,528 domains deposited up to 2004.
